name: Create Text Question
description: Creates a new text question in a Google Form. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/forms/api/reference/rest/v1/forms/batchUpdate)

configurable_props.name: index
configurable_props.label: Index
configurable_props.description: The index of an item in the form. This must be in the range [0..N), where N is the number of items in the form.

configurable_props.name: paragraph
configurable_props.label: Paragraph
configurable_props.description: Whether the question is a paragraph question or not. If not, the question is a short text question.
